description: This source file defines various enums, structs, and functions related to execution approval mechanisms, security configurations, pattern validation, and cache management within the OpenClaw project. It manages permissions, security policies, allowlist patterns, snapshots, and cache of skill binaries.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: An actor that caches skill binary names and paths, refreshing periodically to optimize lookup and trust evaluation.

classes.name: SkillBinTrustIndex
classes.description: A data structure representing a trust index of skill binaries, including names and resolved paths.

methods.name: normalizeSkillBinName
methods.description: Normalizes a skill bin name by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedPath
methods.description: Standardizes a file path for comparison and storage.

methods.name: buildTrustIndex
methods.description: Builds a trust index from a skills status report and search paths.

methods.name: resolveSkillBinPath
methods.description: Resolves the path for a given skill bin name using search paths.

methods.name: _testBuildTrustIndex
methods.description: Test method for building trust index, used in testing scenarios.
